name: How long does the interior log sealing process take to complete and dry?

mainEntity.name: How long does the interior log sealing process take to complete and dry?

acceptedAnswer.text: Interior log sealing on an average residential space usually takes between three and seven business days, depending on wall square footage and prep requirements. The physical application of chinking and clear coats moves quickly, but proper cure times between coats dictate the schedule. Water-based interior sealants and chinking dry to the touch within hours, but they need several days to fully cure and stabilize before heavy cleaning or furniture replacement. Managing indoor airflow and keeping room temperatures stable helps maintain consistent drying times across all treated timber surfaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most interior projects take three to seven days to prep and seal, with full product curing taking several additional days depending on indoor temperature and ventilation.
